description: Statically analyzes a supplied systemPrompt (not a live agent) for demographic bias, proxy-variable leakage, and regulatory risks under one selected complianceDomain (employment_eeoc, housing_fair, lending_ecoa, children_coppa, or eu_ai_act). Read-only, zero-retention, LLM-backed scoring (variance explains idempotentHint=false); requires a Pro/Trial API key. Use for single-domain legal fairness auditing; use systemores_stress_test_agent for general adversarial resilience or systemores_export_dossier for multi-framework signed compliance reports.

complianceDomain.description: The legal compliance framework to evaluate against (employment, housing, lending, COPPA child safety, or EU AI Act 2024/1689).

systemPrompt.description: The underwriting, hiring, housing, or EU AI Act high-risk agent system prompt to evaluate. Maximum 8,000 characters.

name: systemores_assess_bias
title: Assess Regulatory & Demographic Bias
